name: Novena & Newton
summary: Medical hub convenience, food streets, and mid-town access without full CBD intensity.
body: Novena’s hospital cluster and Newton’s food reputation make this a practical mid-town choice. Condos along the CTE/Thomson corridor offer family layouts with relatively fast CBD access. It is less ‘expat village’ than Holland V, which some people prefer. Expect medical traffic, food queues, and a mix of older and newer towers.
housingMix: Mid-to-large condos; some landed pockets toward Newton.
commuteNotes: North-South Line (Novena, Newton); Downtown Line nearby.
